select event_id as eventId, event_type as eventType, from_status as fromStatus, to_status as toStatus, operator_member_id as operatorMemberId, operator_user_id as operatorUserId, event_data_json as eventDataJson, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_event where alliance_order_id = #{allianceOrderId} and is_delete = 0 order by create_time asc, event_id asc

select settlement_id as settlementId, source_member_id as sourceMemberId, receiver_member_id as receiverMemberId, settlement_amount as settlementAmount, express_amount as expressAmount, compensation_amount as compensationAmount, settlement_status as settlementStatus, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, date_format(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime, remark from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_settlement where alliance_order_id = #{allianceOrderId} and is_delete = 0 order by settlement_id desc

select count(1) as totalOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as confirmedOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as disputedOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as closedOrderCount, coalesce(sum(settlement_amount), 0) as settlementAmount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 0 then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as pendingSettlementAmount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 1 then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as confirmedSettlementAmount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 2 then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as disputedSettlementAmount, coalesce(sum(case when settlement_status = 3 then settlement_amount else 0 end), 0) as closedSettlementAmount, coalesce(sum(express_amount), 0) as expressAmount, coalesce(sum(compensation_amount), 0) as compensationAmount from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_settlement where is_delete = 0
